name: greenroom
description: A local, no-code app for running Playwright end-to-end checks against your live web app and reviewing the results.
author: Tjakoen Stolk
//dependencies: RUNTIME deps resolve ANONYMOUSLY from the public npm registry: a fresh clone installs with no token and no .npmrc. The shared layer (@tjakoen/batch, grain, mill, proof) is published to npmjs under the @tjakoen scope, pinned to exact versions for reproducibility. DEV-ONLY CAVEAT: @tjakoen/pantry (component-catalog cockpit, never imported at runtime) is still a github git-dep whose graph nests several levels deep, which npm cannot resolve, so use bun install. bun.lock is gitignored for the same reason. @tjakoen/crumb (guided tours) is a normal dependency now that it is on npmjs; server.ts still imports it via a variable specifier inside try/catch, so the app degrades to tours-disabled rather than failing to boot if it is ever absent. PLATFORM DEPS, each justified in plans/platform.md section 8: better-auth + @better-auth/sso, drizzle-orm over embedded bun:sqlite, monaco-editor.
//devDependencies: @tjakoen/pantry (the component-catalog cockpit) was removed as a devDependency: nothing in this repo imports it, and it was the single cause of three problems — it pinned a github git-dep graph bun could not resolve from scratch (hence no committed lockfile), it broke npm install outright via a dead commit pin, and it required @tjakoen/mill ^0.1.2 which does not exist on npmjs, blocking a tokenless install. Run the cockpit from its own checkout instead; pantry.config.json is kept for it.
